name: LEMURS study (Lived Experiences Measured Using Rings Study)
why: UVM's LEMURS follows first-year college students with Oura rings (about 600 students from fall 2022, a second cohort in fall 2023, 25,000+ sleep periods), finding two basic shapes of sleeping heart rate and links between nightly resting HR, sleep and stress. A team analysing overnight HR at scale is a natural design partner for ECG-based overnight data.
why_now: Cohorts are followed through college; new waves create room for a second device.
ask: Offer DevKit units for an ECG-vs-ring comparison sub-study in the next cohort
opener: Hi, I'm the founder of Vybe Health. I read the LEMURS paper on the two shapes of sleeping heart rate.
